summary_ja: この告示を平成26年3月31日から適用し、第1条及び第3条の規定は同年4月1日から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from March 31, 2014, with Articles 1 and 3 applying from April 1, 2014.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2014; provided, however, that the following provisions apply from April 1 of the same year: (i) The provisions of Articles 1 and 3.
